claim: HA Glances integration issue #32328 (HA 0.106.0, Docker, opened Feb 2020, closed/stale, assigned fabaff): after a restart some Glances sensors get renamed with a '_2' suffix (e.g. machine_etc_hostname_used_percent → machine_etc_hostname_used_percent_2), breaking dashboard cards for containers_*, cpu_*, ram_*, swap_*, thread and total sensors
stance_target: entity-id churn is a distinct Glances failure mode; MQTT discovery with stable per-host unique_ids (as ha-linux-agent publishes) avoids restart-rename breakage
scope_conditions: Home Assistant 0.106.0 in Docker; triggered by restart; regression introduced by 0.106 integration changes
quoted_support: Now, when I restart HA, some sensors are renamed with a _2 after their name. This has happened with all sensors, but not all at once. ... Then today, I noticed that my cards for containers_*, cpu_*, ram_*, swap_*, thread and total disappeared because of this renaming.

claim: The only workaround for the Glances restart-rename bug at the time was removing and re-adding the integration via the web UI — and the renaming recurred on the next restart
stance_target: manual UI fiddling per host per restart is unacceptable at fleet scale; entity identity must be stable by design
quoted_support: This renaming is undone if I remove then re-add the integration using the web UI until the next restart. Then it happens again.
